description: Source code for the IPEndPoint class handling IP address endpoints, including serialization, deserialization, socket address conversions, and platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: IPEndPoint
classes.description: Represents an IP address endpoint with serialization, deserialization, and platform-specific socket address conversions.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Deserializes an IPEndPoint from a base::Value dictionary.

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the IPEndPoint to a base::Value dictionary.

methods.name: GetForAllInterfaces
methods.description: Creates an IPEndPoint for all network interfaces on the specified port (platform-specific).

methods.name: ToSbSocketAddress
methods.description: Converts the IPEndPoint to a platform-specific SbSocketAddress (platform-specific).

methods.name: FromSbSocketAddress
methods.description: Initializes the IPEndPoint from a platform-specific SbSocketAddress (platform-specific).

methods.name: GetFamily
methods.description: Returns the address family of the IP address.

methods.name: GetSockAddrFamily
methods.description: Returns the socket address family constant.

methods.name: ToSockAddr
methods.description: Fills a sockaddr structure with the IP address and port.

methods.name: FromSockAddr
methods.description: Initializes the IPEndPoint from a sockaddr structure.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the IP address with port.

methods.name: ToStringWithoutPort
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the IP address without port.
